verdict.rationale: Fedora documents its own graphical software catalog: one-click installs of desktop apps from Fedora's repositories and Flathub, plus install, update and manage tooling (fedora-docs-8, fedora-docs-12). That gives switchers a browsable catalog, but nothing in the pack shows searching that catalog or filtering it by category. The Super-key desktop search (fedora-docs-6) is a different feature, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented search within the app catalog, category browsing or filtering, and independent hands-on corroboration of finding familiar software through it.
